resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 1901 and 1905 dates are the appropriation and the commissioning. Bradner is said by the NRHP to give 1902 (construction start); the light was first shown 24 April 1905.
NRHP says 24 April 1962; Lighthouse Friends and the Chesapeake chapter say 1938 with a Coast Guard crew until 1962. The story states both.

notes_for_editor: Core chronology rests on the NRHP nomination (Eshelman 1996, revised 2002), which cites Light-House Board reports for 1902-1905 that are not in the local corpus; Lighthouse Friends independently quotes the same reports. The nomination says work resumed 23 March 1904 after stopping 24 January, which is almost certainly 1903 (tow was April 1903); the story gives no year. Automation date conflicts (1962 vs 1938). The Chesapeake chapter bio of Yeatman gives later postings (Drum Point 1918) while Lighthouse Friends says Blackistone Island 1918; the chapter's age of 5 for the daughter is not used. Sleigh anecdote is undated and second-hand. Keeper roster is the USLHS archive's, not checked against NARA registers; Tyler/Taylor spelling differs between the archive and the chapter. 1899 and 1901 report pages are cited by the report index (no page labels in the corpus). Current ownership after 2015 not independently confirmed beyond Lighthouse Digest and the chapter page (updated 2026) calling it active.
